title: Strip published-side footnote residue from the Norway compare lane

sections: F-05 — Footnote-marker digits leak into the published compare text
F-06 — Footnote-anchor whitespace in published text

objective: Extend the Norway compare-only text normalization so published-side footnote residue (a trailing footnote marker digit before a final period, and the space a stripped footnote anchor leaves before a closing parenthesis) stops registering as replay-vs-consolidation divergence, without touching replay materialization.
preflightChecks: src/lawvm/norway/verify.py defines _NO_COMPARISON_NORMALIZATION_RULES as a tuple of ComparisonNormalizationRule entries.
normalize_no_comparison_text in src/lawvm/norway/verify.py applies _NO_COMPARISON_NORMALIZATION_RULES to its input.
The punctuation-spacing character class in src/lawvm/norway/verify.py does not cover a closing parenthesis.
Both compared bodies in src/lawvm/norway/verify.py pass through _normalize_no_compare_tree before divergence detection.
no-divergence for no/lov/2019-12-20-109 at as-of 2026-07-10 shows consolidated text ending Kongen bestemmer 1.
no-divergence for no/lov/2018-06-15-44 at as-of 2026-07-10 shows a space before the closing parenthesis after 910/2014.
requirements: Add typed ComparisonNormalizationRule entries, rule_class presentation_cleanup, following the naming family of the existing no_compare_* rules.
One rule removes the space a stripped footnote anchor leaves before a closing parenthesis.
One rule removes a trailing footnote marker digit that the published extraction leaves between the final word and the final period of a text unit.
Bound the trailing-digit rule so genuine numbered statute text is untouched, and encode that bound in tests with realistic Norwegian counter-examples that must NOT be altered.
Cover both real corpus shapes in tests: Kongen bestemmer 1. normalizing to Kongen bestemmer. and 910/2014 ) normalizing to 910/2014).
Normalization stays in the compare-only lane; replay materialization and adjudication behavior are unchanged.
invariants: Existing _NO_COMPARISON_NORMALIZATION_RULES entries keep their names, order relative to each other, and behavior.
Both compared trees receive identical normalization.
No consolidated-text authority widens over replay: rules may only erase presentation residue, never rewrite operative wording.
exclusions: The akkord/rekonstruksjonsforhandling mismatch in no/lov/2019-12-20-109 (findings ledger F-03) is a commencement question, not compare noise.
Findings-ledger and progress-ledger updates: those are the human apply step.
stopConditions: If the trailing-digit rule cannot be bounded without altering genuine statute text such as list items or section references ending in a digit and period, abort and record the counter-example instead of shipping a loose rule.
reviewFocus: Construct realistic Norwegian legal sentences the new rules would wrongly alter; a normalization rule that can eat operative text is a blocking defect.
Verify symmetry: the rules run on both compare sides, so confirm a replay-side text carrying the same shape is normalized identically rather than creating a new mismatch.

targeted.command: uv run ruff check src/lawvm/norway/verify.py tests/test_norway_verify.py --no-fix
uv run ty check src/lawvm/norway/verify.py tests/test_norway_verify.py

instructions: uv run lawvm no-divergence no/lov/2019-12-20-109 --as-of 2026-07-10 — the Kongen bestemmer footnote-digit MISMATCH is gone; exactly one divergence remains (the F-03 akkord mismatch).
uv run lawvm no-divergence no/lov/2018-06-15-44 --as-of 2026-07-10 — the law reports zero divergences.
uv run lawvm no-divergence no/lov/2015-05-12-27 --as-of 2026-07-10 — the Kongen fastset footnote-digit MISMATCH is gone; the statsforvaltaren mismatches (F-04) remain.
uv run lawvm no-verify-scan --limit 50 --as-of 2026-07-10 — consistent count rises from 11 to 12 (no/lov/2018-06-15-44 becomes consistent) and no law that was consistent before is divergent now.
Update notes/NORWAY_VERIFY_FINDINGS_LEDGER.md: F-05 and F-06 to fixed with the apply commit, scoreboard row, changelog line.
